title: Source: src/agent_runtime/runtime_purge
summary: File ownership, boundaries, state and collaborators.
html:
Source contracts: src/agent_runtime/runtime_purge

src/agent_runtime/runtime_purge/init.py

Python · Tier A

Identify the owner-only Controller maintenance package. coordinator accepts durable purge intent and manages online restart/reconciliation; storage prepares and verifies the replacement generation under exclusive bootstrap ownership. cli exposes local offline recovery, while inventory and preservation define what survives. This package initializer registers no routes or tools and performs no purge work on import.

src/agent_runtime/runtime_purge/checkpoint_setup.py

Python · Tier A

Capture reusable native setup independently of disposable run history during checkpoint publication. capture selects live policy and managed-file metadata from the pinned snapshot, writes a versioned sidecar and binds its checksum to the native domain entry. Offline recovery can then read preserved setup even when the mixed native snapshot is damaged; the ordinary checkpoint owner still publishes the manifest.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
capture 23 Write an independently readable native setup sidecar for one checkpoint snapshot. Select live row identities from non-disposable collections, thaw their values and record the snapshot revision. Add its checksum reference to the supplied native domain manifest entry; disposable run history and managed file bodies are not copied here.

src/agent_runtime/runtime_purge/cli.py

Python · Tier A

Expose local offline runtime-purge recovery without starting the application or contacting remote targets. main parses existing flags and formats the result; run obtains exclusive ownership, previews or resumes a durable journal, and applies the local generation. Paired Gateway identities are recorded for later online reconciliation. Invalid confirmation, live ownership, relocation or preservation failures prevent completion and return explicit errors.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
run 23 Run local recovery under exclusive offline bootstrap ownership, without loading disposable history or contacting Gateways. Dry-run returns the local estimate; destructive execution requires the exact confirmation. Reuse an unfinished journal or record a new operation with paired remote identities for later online reconciliation. Apply the Controller generation and persist blocked status on failure before re-raising.
main 66 Parse the existing config, dry-run and confirmation arguments without initializing stores. Print the resulting preview/journal as JSON and return zero; expected configuration, ownership or I/O failures print to stderr and return one. Argument parsing retains argparse exit behavior.

src/agent_runtime/runtime_purge/coordinator.py

Python · Tier A

Own the authenticated Controller purge workflow and its progress API. Coordinator previews targets, journals exact acceptance, drains execution and requests a restart after confirmed saving. Bootstrap storage owns actual local deletion; transport reconciles paired Gateways independently. Polling resumes retained monitors only when their target dependencies are ready. Durable IDs, per-target status and blocked outcomes survive request disconnects and process restarts.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
Coordinator 38 Coordinate owner-requested maintenance across the Controller and paired Gateways using a persistent journal. The request path accepts intent, stops work and requests a restart; storage recovery performs local deletion only under exclusive bootstrap ownership. Separate polling reconciles remote targets and resumes eligible saved monitors.
Coordinator.targets 50 Include the local Controller and every paired Gateway, including disabled entries that may retain history. Estimate local storage only for preview; acceptance can record identities without walking storage. Unpaired Gateway records are excluded.
Coordinator.preview 68 Combine local storage and active-work counts with up to eight concurrent Gateway capability previews. Return preserve/delete/exclusion labels and the exact confirmation phrase. An unreachable or incompatible target remains visible; this method neither accepts intent nor stops execution.
Coordinator.start 128 Require the exact confirmation and durably record all target identities plus pre-shutdown monitor states before entering maintenance. Return an existing unfinished operation, or the same completed submission, without another restart. Validate pending relocation first; only after journal success begin shutdown and schedule the shared restart task.
Coordinator._restart 185 Drain tracked work and reconcile Gateways while awaiting the shared durable Controller shutdown. If ordinary stopping stalls before saving, terminate only recorded native process identities and retry the wait; once saving begins, await its outcome. Require confirmed persistence before invoking the restart callback/supervisor. Any failure records a blocked Controller without deleting its state here.
Coordinator.retry 251 Resume the existing operation after its cause is addressed. If local completion is outstanding, start one restart attempt unless one is already active; otherwise reconcile remote targets with explicit blocked-target retry enabled. Return the latest journal.
Coordinator.start_polling 265 Attach the asynchronous reconciliation loop to the current event loop; the lifecycle owner must close it during teardown.
Coordinator._poll 271 Every three seconds, reconcile partial operations and attempt eligible monitor resumption. Log per-pass failures and continue until the stop event is set so an unavailable target does not discard durable progress.
Coordinator.resume_monitors 288 After Controller verification, consume retained monitor IDs as they disappear, become ineligible or successfully restart. Start only queued, unarchived definitions whose required Gateways are ready. Persist the remaining IDs so a restart can continue the handoff.
Coordinator.close 314 Signal and await the polling loop during application teardown. The purge restart task belongs to the separate shutdown/restart workflow and is not cancelled by this polling cleanup.
automation_ready 323 Gate fresh automation against the current purge journal. Explicit Gateway selections require only their matching targets to be completed; an empty selection requires every remote target. With no bound operation there is no purge-specific restriction.
register 338 Install owner-authenticated preview, acceptance, status and retry HTTP routes and attach their coordinator to app state. Responses disable caching. These maintenance endpoints are separate from model tools and never perform the destructive bootstrap phase inline.
register.preview 355 Require the installation owner, then run storage walks and remote preview probes in a worker thread and return their no-cache result.
register.status 362 Return the current durable operation, or idle when no journal exists, to an authenticated owner. Reading progress does not trigger maintenance.
register.operation 369 Return only the current operation matching the requested ID; owner authentication precedes the lookup and an absent/different ID returns 404.
register.start 381 Read and validate the owner request, rejecting bodies over 1,024 bytes after reading them. Pass exact confirmation and optional submission identity to durable acceptance, returning HTTP 202. Invalid input returns 400; capacity/quota failures return 507 and other I/O failures a safe 500 detail.
register.retry 409 Require owner access and the exact current operation ID before retrying its unfinished targets. Return the accepted journal with HTTP 202; a stale ID cannot address a different operation.

src/agent_runtime/runtime_purge/inference.py

Python · Tier A

Separate reusable Controller inference setup from disposable logs, jobs and process secrets during runtime purge. paths defines the bounded local deletion set, prepare stages classified records and stopped desired state, and publish installs verified setup with atomic replacement. External hosts, downloaded model files and installed runtimes are outside these paths. Unknown record kinds, schemas or malformed setup fail before destructive recovery can proceed.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
root 37 Locate Controller-owned inference state beside the configured native run database. This does not select model download roots or external inference hosts.
paths 44 Enumerate only disposable local inference logs, jobs, process receipts, temporary secrets and portal database/sidecars. Saved setup and non-process secrets are staged separately before these paths can be removed.
prepare 60 Read the existing portal database in read-only mode and stage known reusable record kinds into a fresh version-one database. Strip runtime state down to retained desired/snapshot fields with stopped status, and drop process-scoped secrets. Unknown kinds, newer schemas or malformed preserved values stop recovery. Return whether an inference database was staged; secrets may be staged independently.
publish 138 Restore sanitized inference secrets and atomically replace the portal database from verified prepared setup. Flush the replacement before directory synchronization. Keep the prepared originals until the whole purge verifies, allowing retries after partial publication.

src/agent_runtime/runtime_purge/inventory.py

Python · Tier A

Declare the complete preservation policy for Controller runtime purge. Collection and root maps classify reusable setup, mixed definitions and disposable execution history; validate_inventory checks them against current domain schemas and managed roots. Storage and checkpoint_setup consume the same decisions. New storage must receive an explicit policy here before purge can safely accept its ownership.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
validate_inventory 275 Require every current Controller domain and collection to match an explicit preserved, mixed or disposable decision. Also require known managed roots to be classified. Fail before deletion when schema/root ownership expands without a corresponding review.

src/agent_runtime/runtime_purge/preservation.py

Python · Tier A

Adapt reusable definitions to a fresh execution generation without erasing their authored content. context and recipe remove typed provenance; adapt resets observed state, advances schedules and detaches saved monitors. references discovers managed body IDs, and row codecs bridge prepared SQL storage. These transformations operate on decoded values; storage performs ownership checks, file verification and durable publication.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
context 37 Copy a definition context while dropping the explicitly named previous-execution fields. Recurse only into native activity target contexts; arbitrary user objects and string substrings are not generic scrub targets.
recipe 52 Detach workflow provenance and reset execution counters while retaining the authored definition. Apply the same context cleanup to metadata in either decoded representation, returning a new top- level mapping.
adapt 68 Transform one decoded reusable row for the fresh generation without changing user-authored values. Clear usage, provenance and observations; advance active/paused schedules without replaying missed triggers; detach saved monitors and queue previously running ones. Return None only for explicitly model-led transient monitors, and otherwise return the adapted row.
references 156 Collect exact ctx_/art_ managed identifiers from values nested in retained objects. Dictionary keys and arbitrary filesystem paths are not ownership references; callers still verify the referenced bodies before retaining them.
decode_row 172 Decode only schema-declared JSON columns in a preserved SQL row, keeping SQL NULL unchanged. Malformed JSON propagates to the caller so required setup cannot silently become defaults.
encode_row 181 Serialize decoded values only for declared JSON columns when building fresh SQL setup. Preserve nulls and other scalar columns; serialization errors stop the preparation phase.

src/agent_runtime/runtime_purge/process_ownership.py

Python · Tier A

Persist independent ownership receipts for Controller inference workers so purge need not trust disposable job history. attach marks legacy uncertainty and records each launched child identity and retires receipts after verified supervisor cleanup. reap reconciles surviving workers at Controller lifecycle boundaries; stop additionally rejects unverifiable legacy work before purge. Only recorded PID/creation identities reach the termination verifier. Failure retains receipts rather than treating a guessed PID or missing receipt as confirmed cleanup.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
active_legacy 17 Detect old inference reservations or starting/running/ready job/state records lacking independent process receipts. These records mean ownership cannot safely be inferred from a clean new marker.
attach 31 Install the inference supervisor ownership callback and create a versioned marker recording pre- existing unverified work. Each new child receives an independent PID/creation-identity receipt, so recovery can verify workers without loading disposable portal history.
stop 65 Refuse an unsupported marker or unverified legacy active work. When no marker exists, inspect the legacy portal read-only before trusting it. Expand recorded process identities through owned_command and require verified termination; uncertain ownership leaves runtime data retained.
reap 109 Reap recorded workers before recovery or final close, retaining failed receipts. This runs only at the installation owner's lifecycle boundary, after current launches have drained or before new launches are admitted. It never infers ownership from a port, executable name or saved instance status.

src/agent_runtime/runtime_purge/storage.py

Python · Tier A

Replace Controller runtime history with a verified setup-only recovery generation. preview reports bounded owned roots, prepare extracts/adapts reusable rows and verifies referenced bodies, and apply_pending publishes then retires old generations under exclusive bootstrap ownership. The persistent journal records forward recovery stages, fixed store bindings, retained files and per-target completion. Corrupt required setup, unsafe paths or uncertain ownership stop progress without substituting defaults.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
journal 37 Open the instance-specific persistent purge journal beneath the Controller runtime root. The journal survives generation replacement and is separate from disposable conversation history.
roots 46 Resolve the closed local deletion inventory, including configured store sidecars, obsolete generations and managed payload roots. Reject unclassified runtime-root entries and unsafe paths before returning targets; this inventory does not traverse user workspaces or model downloads.
managed_roots 79 Map the three reusable-body containers to their configured owners: context/generated artifacts beside native state, and workflow assets beside recipes. These roots need selective retention rather than unconditional removal.
preview 92 Return a local storage estimate across owned roots, or a blocked result with the ownership error. Missing size information remains unknown instead of being reported as zero. This does not validate every preserved collection or authorize deletion.
_source 113 Choose exact committed checkpoint sources for every domain, preferring the independently checksummed native setup sidecar. Permit legacy paths only when no committed generation exists. Reject unsafe generation/file names, missing domain coverage or ambiguous checkpoint contents before recovering rows.
_rows 157 Yield decoded rows only from selected preserved/mixed tables. Verify native setup sidecars or stream native snapshot live rows; otherwise inspect SQL read-only and reject unknown/missing required tables. Missing committed sources and malformed preserved data abort recovery, while an absent legacy store contributes no rows.
prepare 244 Build a fresh setup-only generation before deleting anything. Adapt selected rows, verify required context/artifact/workflow bodies, detach their old execution ownership and stage sanitized inference setup. Flush/checksum every prepared store and write recovery metadata, retained-file identities and monitor-resume IDs. Failures leave original runtime history intact; fault hooks exercise restart boundaries.
apply_pending 444 Replay an accepted purge only under exclusive, empty bootstrap ownership and unchanged configured store bindings. Verify staged setup and preflight all deletion roots, publish the new manifest, then retire old history and relocate retained bodies. Restore inference setup, validate the generation and bodies, record the epoch/completion receipt and remove temporary metadata. Durable journal flags make interrupted stages resume forward without restoring retired history.
validate_location 603 Reject a pending or prepared storage relocation before purge acceptance/recovery. The original configured instance paths must remain stable while its journal is unfinished.
recover 616 Replay purge before import/relocation recovery can reintroduce retired history. On failure, attempt to mark the Controller blocked with a safe diagnostic, preserve the prior journal if that write also fails, and propagate the original recovery error.

src/agent_runtime/runtime_purge/transport.py

Python · Tier A

Coordinate remote Gateway maintenance from the Controller while fencing execution on unfinished targets. request uses owner management HTTPS or the authenticated outbound session; reconcile observes operation identity, capability, verified restart and release before completion. allowed returns the new epoch only for completed matches. Unavailable or incompatible targets retain visible progress and cannot be silently treated as cleaned.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
bind 21 Bind the Controller settings used by the process-wide execution fence. Later allowed checks read this instance journal without starting reconciliation.
target_record 28 Snapshot a paired Gateway identity and its restart-compatible HTTPS/outbound route into a pending journal target. No request is sent and storage estimates remain unknown until preview.
request 47 Send one owner maintenance action through the paired outbound session or authenticated Gateway management HTTPS client. Use a five-second request timeout and bounded HTTPS body read; missing sessions, malformed responses and transport failures propagate to reconciliation.
allowed 80 Permit maintenance routes while fencing execution on any matching unfinished Gateway target. A completed target returns the operation epoch for fresh work; absent/unbound targets return no purge epoch. Match either paired identity or outbound node, without reopening an unfinished target.
reconcile 106 For each unfinished remote target, observe status before deciding its next action. Release only matching locally verified operations; otherwise check capability/ownership, prepare and request purge, retaining pending restart verification. Completed targets are skipped and blocked operations require explicit retry when reported by the Gateway. Record incompatible/unavailable targets and finish the overall journal only after the Controller and all remotes complete.
